叶清秋自那天起才知道什么是生不如死，她不知道那个男人用了什么办法保住了她的命，但是她多希望那个时候自己和龙玦一起死了。

她不但要自己服侍他，还要到外面去抓年轻貌美的处子来给他享用，他已经不需要水灵根的女子，只要是个没有破身的女子，他都要。

她不是没想过逃跑，可是每次都会抓回去，被抓到的惩罚绝对是她不能承受的，之后她就在也不敢跑了。

因为她的身体这么多年滋养得很好，所以对他来说就像是一件需要慢慢消化的补品，她只要乖乖听他的话，她的日子也还算过得去。

惨的就是那些她抓回的少女，被他折磨得都看不出人形。

“最近失踪那么女子，这事已经惊动了上面管事的，听说已经派人来查了。”

“哼……谁知道是不是他们那些魔族……”

“嘘，你不要命了，现在修真界是魔族的地盘，以后这种话可不要在说了。”

叶清秋面无表情的从他们身边过去，已经引起魔族的人注意力了吗？

回到她住的村子，叶清秋低着头，对床上盘腿而坐的男人道：“魔族已经发现有人失踪，我们要不要换个地方？”

她也不是没想过让魔族的人来对付他，可是这个男人握着自己的小命，他死了，自己肯定也活不了。

“这么快就发现了？”男人哼了一声，“也罢，本尊暂时还不能和君无期对上，等本尊恢复了实力，魔君迟早是本尊的。”

叶清秋抬头看他，男人正盯着她，眼底隐隐有诡异的光泽，叶清秋心头一跳，垂在身侧的手死死的拽着衣摆。

男人一把将叶清秋拉到床上。

两人在修真界躲躲藏藏，在魔族的人发现不对劲，立即就换个地方。

修真界失踪的人越来越多，这事直接惊动了君无期。

魔族女子很少，所以失踪的基本都是修真界女修，这事已经影响到修真界的秩序，必须查出来。

君无期和男人的较量持续了很长一段时间，最后还是君无期胜了。

“不要杀我……都是他逼我的……不要杀我，不要杀我……”叶清秋气息奄奄的躺在地上，她容貌有些苍老，但并不影响她的美貌，此时哭得凄惨无比，看上去着实有几分可怜。

“叶清秋，这都是你咎由自取的，你把那个恶魔放了出来，是你用几百年的时间让他恢复实力。”君无期没有半分同情的道。

“不是我……是他主动和我契约的，是他……不是我的错，为什么要这么对我，明明是他……”叶清秋语无伦次的说着。

都是他，是那个恶魔，是他毁了自己。

还有商殊！

那个贱人！

她要杀了她！

君无期摇头，“当初你为何和他契约的前因，你忘记了吗？”

Ye Qingqiu only knew what life was worse than death from that day on. She didn't know what method the man used to save her life, but she wished she and Long Jue had died together at that time.

Not only does she have to serve him herself, but she also wants to go out and capture young and beautiful virgins for him to enjoy. He no longer needs a woman with water spirit roots, as long as she is a virgin, he wants it.

It's not that she never thought about running away, but she would catch him back every time. The punishment of being caught was definitely something she couldn't bear. After that, she didn't dare to run away anymore.

Because her body had been well nourished over the years, it was like a tonic to him that needed to be digested slowly. As long as she obeyed him, her life would be pretty good.

The worst thing was that the girls she captured were tortured to the point where they couldn't even see their human form.

"So many women have disappeared recently. This matter has alarmed the people in charge above. I heard that people have been sent to investigate."

"Hmph...who knows if it's those demons..."

"Shh, you're dying. The world of cultivation is the domain of the demons now. Don't say such things again in the future."

Ye Qingqiu passed by them expressionlessly. Has he attracted the attention of the demon clan?

Back in the village where she lived, Ye Qingqiu lowered her head and said to the man sitting cross-legged on the bed: "The demon clan has discovered that someone is missing. Should we change places?"

It's not like she hasn't thought about letting the demons deal with him, but this man holds her life in his hands. If he dies, she will definitely not survive.

"You discovered it so soon?" The man snorted, "It doesn't matter, I can't face Jun Wuji for the time being. When I regain my strength, the Demon Lord will be my own sooner or later."

Ye Qingqiu looked up at him. The man was staring at her, with a strange glint in his eyes. Ye Qingqiu's heart skipped a beat, and the hand hanging by his side was holding on to the hem of his clothes.

The man pulled Ye Qingqiu onto the bed.

The two of them were hiding in the world of cultivation. The people in the demon clan noticed something was wrong and immediately changed places.

More and more people are missing in the world of cultivation, and this incident directly alarms Jun Wuqi.

There are very few demon women, so the missing ones are basically female cultivators in the world of cultivation. This matter has affected the order of the world of cultivation and must be found out.

The contest between Jun Wuqi and the man lasted for a long time, and in the end Jun Wuqi won.

"Don't kill me... He forced me... Don't kill me, don't kill me..." Ye Qingqiu was lying on the ground dying. She looked a little old, but it did not affect her beauty. She was crying miserably at this time, and she looked a bit pitiful.

"Ye Qingqiu, you brought this upon yourself. You released that demon and it took you hundreds of years to restore his strength." Jun Wuqi said without any sympathy.

"It's not me...it was him who took the initiative to make a contract with me. It was him...it's not my fault. Why do you treat me like this? It's obviously him..." Ye Qingqiu said incoherently.

It was him, the devil, who destroyed himself.

And Shang Shu!

That bitch!

She's going to kill her!

Jun Wuqi shook his head, "Have you forgotten the reason why you made the contract with him in the first place?"
